- Financial - Watch for follow-through on an RS cross trigger vs SPY; confirmed if relative strength holds above its cross level on expanding volume, invalidated if the relative ratio falls back below the signal line.
- Real Estate - Watch for continuation on an RS cross trigger vs SPY; confirmed by sustained outperformance into the close, invalidated if RS quickly slips back into negative territory.
- Basic Materials - Watch the RS new high trigger to confirm persistent institutional leadership; confirmed if relative strength pushes further into new highs, invalidated if the ratio experiences an immediate, high-volume pullback.
- Consumer Cyclical - Watch the RS new high trigger for fresh upside momentum; confirmed by another 20-session RS breakout, invalidated if RS rolls over and slips back below the prior multi-week range.
- Consumer Defensive - Watch the RS new high trigger to gauge ongoing defensive rotation; confirmed if the 20-session high holds and expands, invalidated if relative strength sharply retreats beneath previous resistance.
